name: v-refresh
js: (async()=>{ const E=[]; addEventListener('error',e=>E.push(e.message)); scrollTo(0,3000); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); location.reload(); return 'reloading'; })()

name: v-price
js: (async()=>{ for (let y=0;y<6300;y+=500){scrollTo(0,y); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,150));} scrollTo(0,6150); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1500)); return 1})()

name: v-bento
js: (async()=>{ for (let y=0;y<4900;y+=500){scrollTo(0,y); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,150));} document.querySelector('.bx-bill').scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1500)); const b=document.querySelector('.bx-bill'); return b.scrollHeight - b.clientHeight })()
